name: PhD in Biological Sciences

english.toefl: 86 overall; Reading 22, Listening 22, Speaking 20, Writing 22 (published legacy scale)
english.note: IELTS Reading/Listening 6.5, Speaking/Writing 6.0. DET Literacy 105, Conversation 95, Comprehension 115, Production 90. Below any minimum means no review. Unofficial copies accepted initially; admitted students accepting must supply official scores by April 15. Main page offers exemptions for degrees completed fully in residence in US/majority-English countries within four years; FAQ says tests always required and permits eligible older scores up to five years. Follow stricter FAQ and confirm the conflict.

applicationFee.note: Same fee for all applicants; waiver requests will not be considered.

documents: Unofficial transcripts; official copies only after admission
International transcripts: course-by-course WES evaluation, uploaded unofficial scan plus unofficial transcript; do not send official WES during application
Statement of purpose, 1–2 pages: research experience and your role, interests, reasons for PhD and CMU
requirements.note: Recognized four-year bachelor’s degree or equivalent; broad biology preparation and depth in a biological subfield. GRE optional and reviewed if submitted; unofficial initial scores, official if admitted. Letters: At least one from the college most recently attended.

funding.note: All PhD students regardless of national origin receive yearly tuition remission, a competitive stipend and medical insurance. No current stipend amount stated.

summary: Doctoral training in biological sciences with three first-year laboratory rotations.
detailsNote: The official December deadlines do not state an entry year; Fall 2027 is not confirmed.

publishedDeadlines.note: Application closes at 11:59 pm; no entry year or time zone stated.

publishedDeadlines.label: Supporting materials and letters
publishedDeadlines.note: Submit all materials by this date. The main page calls this priority review; the FAQ says required for full consideration and does not accept late applications.

timeline.decisions: All applicants notified by April 1; decisions begin rolling in December/January. Recurring timing, no year stated.
